decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: replied within a day (email:8bd17741) saying they like it and just need to add the team, and first project was already reached 2026-08-31. draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Union Systems' setup
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad it's feeling good so far -- and thanks for the quick reply. Getting the rest of the team in is a good next step: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier with a larger group.

Want me to walk through adding the team on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
